preamble.title: dyma-io/dyma-contracts-cardano
preamble.description: Dyma UTXO smart contracts for Cardano: campaign reward escrow, its registry and the reputation badge

cardano/address/Address.title: Address
cardano/address/Address.description:
A Cardano `Address` typically holding one or two credential references.

 Note that legacy bootstrap addresses (a.k.a. 'Byron addresses') are
 completely excluded from Plutus contexts. Thus, from an on-chain
 perspective only exists addresses of type 00, 01, ..., 07 as detailed
 in [CIP-0019 :: Shelley Addresses](https://github.com/cardano-foundation/CIPs/tree/master/CIP-0019/#shelley-addresses).

cardano/address/Credential.title: Credential
cardano/address/Credential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/PaymentCredential.title: PaymentCredential
cardano/address/PaymentCredential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/StakeCredential.title: StakeCredential
cardano/address/StakeCredential.description:
Represent a type of object that can be represented either inline (by hash)
 or via a reference (i.e. a pointer to an on-chain location).

 This is mainly use for capturing pointers to a stake credential
 registration certificate in the case of so-called pointer addresses.

cardano/transaction/OutputReference.title: OutputReference
cardano/transaction/OutputReference.description:
An `OutputReference` is a unique reference to an output on-chain. The `output_index`
 corresponds to the position in the output list of the transaction (identified by its id)
 that produced that output

dyma/badge/Attestation.title: Attestation
dyma/badge/Attestation.description: What Dyma signs for one claim, with Ed25519 over `blake2b_256(serialise_data(attestation))`.

fields.title: policy
fields.description: The badge script: binds the network and the contract.

fields.title: owner
fields.description: The payment key of the wallet the badge belongs to; it signs the claim.

fields.title: seed
fields.description: An input the claim spends: the attestation works once and names the badge.

anyOf.title: Init
anyOf.description: The one-shot configuration NFT (with the seed).

anyOf.title: Claim
anyOf.description: A badge: its reference and user tokens (retired badges may burn in the same transaction).

anyOf.title: Burn
anyOf.description: Burning only: holders burn their user tokens; retired references burn with their spend.

anyOf.title: Retire
anyOf.description: A badge reference leaves: a newer claim of the same account, or governance (revocation).

dyma/types/Asset.title: Asset
dyma/types/Asset.description: The campaign asset: ADA (empty policy and name) or one native token.

dyma/types/Entry.title: Entry
dyma/types/Entry.description: One committed allocation entry: the earner's payment key and its weight.

anyOf.title: Create
anyOf.description: Funds a new campaign from a ticket signed by Dyma.

anyOf.title: Delegate
anyOf.description:
Mints or burns tokens of campaigns whose state UTxO is spent in the same transaction; the
 state's own validation decides.

dyma/types/Owner.title: Owner
dyma/types/Owner.description:
Who owns a campaign: `credential` authorises owner actions (a key signature, or a script
 spending one of its own inputs in the transaction, e.g. a multisig wallet); `address`
 receives every refund.

anyOf.title: UpdateConfig
anyOf.description: Governance: any change but the global pause history. A new governance must sign too.

anyOf.title: GlobalUnpause
anyOf.description: Guardian or governance, while the latest global pause is active.

dyma/types/Ticket.title: Ticket
dyma/types/Ticket.description:
What Dyma's API signs for one campaign funding attempt: the exact rules the owner's pool
 will follow. Signed with Ed25519 over `blake2b_256(serialise_data(ticket))`.

fields.title: escrow_script
fields.description: The escrow version: its state script (`campaign_state`).

fields.title: seed
fields.description:
An input of the funding transaction: makes the ticket single-use and names the campaign
 key (`blake2b_224(serialise_data(seed))`).

fields.title: max_recipients
fields.description: The Top N bound of the allocation (claim shards are paid from the owner's deposit).

fields.title: state_deposit
fields.description: Lovelace kept in the campaign's state UTxO.
